title: US cesarean delivery rate (% of all births)

source.name: National Vital Statistics System -- births by method of delivery
source.publisher: CDC National Center for Health Statistics (NCHS)

notes: 1970 (5.5%) and 1988 (24.7%) are from NCHS's historical cesarean-rate research (National Hospital Discharge Survey era). 2009 (32.9%) and 2024 (32.4%, the highest since 2013) are from NCHS Data Brief No. 535 (July 2025) and related NVSR releases; the rate dipped to a recent low near 31.7% in 2019 before climbing again through 2024.
